personalized_first_line: Dustin, your site promises 24/7 emergency service across Nassau County, but your Google profile says Monday to Friday, 9 to 5. So I'm curious who picks up when a pipe bursts in Yulee on a Saturday night.
call_angle: Emergency coverage, not growth. The pitch: you already promise 24/7 and your reviews say you respond fast when you're reachable, but the posted hours stop at 5 on weekdays and you're the one under the sink during the day. We built a demo line from your own website that answers the burst-pipe call at 2 a.m. or Saturday, tells real emergencies from routine work, takes the details, and books it into your Housecall Pro flow. Go-live is forwarding only the calls you miss. Qualify with: "Who answers your phones after hours right now: you, voicemail, or nobody?" Then ask for the Game Plan Call. Keep the word "AI" light: this is a family-run, trust-first shop, so frame it as backup for missed calls, not a replacement for Tiffany.
likely_objection: "I answer my own phone 24/7. That's why our reviews say we respond fast." Response: "I believe you, and the reviews back it up. This only catches the ones you can't grab: while you're under a house or driving. Call the demo line yourself and decide." A second likely objection is "Tiffany handles that". Position it as overflow and after-hours backup for her, not a replacement.

The concrete reason to call is the open contradiction between the advertised 24/7 service and the posted weekday-only hours (GBP and the site's own schema, checked 2026-10-28). Reviews are still arriving (the newest is about 2 weeks old), so inbound demand is real.
